heading.html: What Is a Korean Body Scrub?

children.text: A Korean body scrub, also known as seshin, is a traditional, full-body exfoliation treatment that’s been a vital part of Korean skincare and holistic wellness for thousands of years. After a steam or soak in hot water, the skin is vigorously scrubbed head-to-toe using textured mitts to slough off layers of dead skin, leaving it smoother, softer, and more radiant. This deeply cleansing ritual also stimulates circulation and enhances the skin’s ability to absorb moisture.

heading.html: Benefits of Our Women’s Gold Aroma Body Scrub

children.text: A Korean body scrub offers more than just soft skin—it’s a time-honored treatment that promotes deep exfoliation, circulation, and hydration. According to Healthline, body scrubs help remove dead skin cells, improve blood flow, and enhance skin health. Our Gold Aroma Body Scrub offers the same benefits of our women’s Classic Body Scrub, with the added benefit of being longer and using aromatherapy. This takes your body scrub to the next level, leaving your skin even more glowing.

children.html:
Deep Exfoliation for Radiant Skin
  • Removes dead skin cells to reveal a fresher, more glowing complexion
  • Enhances skin texture for a softer, silkier feel
  • Helps unclog pores, reducing breakouts and ingrown hairs
Boosts Circulation & Detoxification
  • Stimulates blood flow, promoting overall skin health
  • Assists in lymphatic drainage to flush out toxins
  • Leaves you feeling refreshed and revitalized
Maximizes Hydration & Product Absorption
  • Prepares skin to better absorb moisturizers and treatments
  • Enhances the effectiveness of oils and lotions for longer-lasting hydration
  • Leaves skin looking and feeling more youthful

children.html:
What is a Korean body scrub?

A Korean body scrub (seshin) is an exfoliating treatment that removes dead skin cells using textured mitts after a hot steam or soak. It leaves skin smoother, improves circulation, and enhances product absorption.

Do I have to be nude for a Korean body scrub?

Yes, nudity is required during the treatment, as is traditional in Korean spas. This allows for a thorough exfoliation and the best results.

How often should I get a Korean body scrub?

Every 4 to 6 weeks is ideal for maintaining smooth, healthy skin. Frequency depends on skin type and personal preference.

Can a body scrub remove dark spots?

 Exfoliation helps fade dark spots by promoting cell renewal. Learn more in our blog: Can Body Scrub Remove Dark Spots?.

Is a Korean body scrub painful?

It can feel intense but is not usually painful. The pressure can be adjusted for comfort.

How should I prepare for a Korean body scrub?

Hydrate well, avoid shaving or waxing 24 hours before, and soak in hot water for at least 15 minutes before the treatment.

What should I do after a Korean body scrub?

Moisturize well, avoid harsh skincare products, and stay hydrated to keep your skin soft and glowing.

How do I book a body scrub at King Spa?

All of our spa treatments, including our body scrubs, must be booked in-person at King Spa. You can easily book your body scrub treatment in the locker room with our friendly staff.

How much does a Gold Aroma body scrub cost?

Please see our pricing page for current treatment pricing information.

What other types of body scrubs are offered at King Spa?

We proudly offer different types of body scrubs for both men, women, and couples!
